reference_graph: Small dense differentiable causal native builder + subject-only native forward, whole logical B; all K/P gradients.

files.causal_builder.py: causal whole-B key/weight/subject-action graph, with memory strategy corrected
files.geometry.py: native means, fixed-A factor, same-A inverse apply/Woodbury, residual checks
files.subject.py: selected-position heads and microbatch v-adjoint accumulation; remove realized-norm/allocation terms
files.profile.py: prefix caches and causal/masked stages with model adapter
files.writer.py: RAM transaction, accepted weight commit and final native history
files.qualification.py: dense/direct/full-native references and geometry-detach negative control

reuse.v12_reuse: EfficiencyAdam requested-budget projection and anchor scaling; not request-independent early-freeze.
reuse.reuse_is_not_drop_in: v10 has unbounded q-Adam, norm on realized v, .1 allocation term, eager all-row GPU activation graphs and a dense weight-gradient intermediate. All require explicit correction.

factors.per_batch: Factor same stored A_l once per eligible layer; invalidate after H changes.
factors.formula: Y=solve(A,K); T=I+K^T Y; P=Y T^-1, implemented via transpose small solve.
factors.backend: Same-A Cholesky when applicable and residual-validated; otherwise same-A LU/native full-system solve. No hidden symmetrization, jitter or rank truncation.
factors.selection: Shape/resource-based qualified backend. If A is singular or inverse-apply invalid, qualified full native solve(A+KK^T,K); no logical-B splitting.
factors.earliest_site: K/P at first eligible site independent of all candidate R; cache after actual adapter verification.
factors.cached_reverse: Use Z=solve(A^T,G_P-K(P^T G_P)) from cached primal P and entry A factors when qualified; otherwise native Bmat transpose factor. Validate Bmat^T Z-G_P; do not recompute primal P or symmetrize A.

execution.actual_causal_builder: Layerwise streaming in native row order; complete whole-B mean K before solving one P_l.
forward_stages: CPU/pinned cache entry prefix and stage-boundary activations
stream row groups to collect native subject keys at current write site
assemble full native K and solve once for this layer/candidate
materialize W_eff once, resume each row group through updated site and intervening blocks
record native subject v and next boundary states; offload checkpointed activations
repeat all eligible sites; never build independent microbatch writers
execution.masked_forward: R4a complete-owner original-no-grad probe, preserving common stop and zero backward for accepted terminal; original full-evaluate/replay fallback. R4b bounded graph streaming optional later.
reverse_stages: accumulate masked-loss adjoints for every v_lrc
reverse eligible stages, recompute a row group with same candidate factors/weights/checkpoint states
accumulate direct R/P adjoints and input-boundary adjoints across all rows
One candidate-wide cached transpose-solve VJP after all row adjoints; first-site key adjoint omitted only under proven causal independence.
native mean VJP returns extra K adjoints to original rewrite row subject keys
replay stage key paths to complete boundary adjoints before moving to lower stage
execution.storage: Microbatch bounds model activation working set; CPU boundary states and whole-B small factors still scale with B. Streaming adds recomputation/transfer; not an unconditional speedup.
execution.no_candidate_accumulation: All replays use candidate-specific payload and fixed entry W/H; gradients include each path exactly once.
execution.all_zero_forward: Do not detach R or skip required P/Jacobian when R=0; every candidate starts with valid derivatives for reentry.

numerical_kernel.canonical_forward: materialized W_entry+FP32(R64 P^T), same native linear and cast/add order
numerical_kernel.direct_RP_VJP_candidate: dR=G^T(XP), dP=X^T(GR); avoid dense G^T X intermediate after parity qualification.
numerical_kernel.warning: Reassociation changes multiplication/accumulation dtype/order. Low-rank forward XW_entry^T+(XP)R^T also changes weight rounding and is not canonical without separate measured acceptance.
numerical_kernel.differentiability: CPU finite differences use smooth FP64 reference; production autograd uses normal floating-point cast derivatives. Bitwise quantized forward is not a mathematically smooth function and must not be claimed as such.

reuse_without_objective_change: native token IDs with only unnecessary right padding removed
causal accepted builder keys for final history only after qualification

portability.sources: ModelAdapter and row metadata provide dimensions, eligible sites, injection/write additive correspondence, context roles, lookup/positions and native nested means.
portability.logical_B: Independent of fit/capture/eval microbatches; preserve native all-column solve, duplicate and zero columns.
portability.request_reduction: Sum objective gradient, mean report; actual B from tail, no hardcoded100.
portability.noncontiguous_layers: Forward/replay through intervening unedited blocks and preserve key dependency.
portability.unsupported: Report missing additive mapping or resource support; do not silently change sites, contexts, precision or B.
portability.row_metadata: Use explicit owner/native-reduction indices, never fixed global_row modulo context count.

qualification.CPU: reference/audit.json; algebra, requested budget/energy, cross-talk and full K/R gradients
qualification.actual: tiny B=1/2/3 with unequal context lengths and tail shapes; native source/cast/add, dense/full-solve versus optimized paths and finite coupled gradients

proposed_tolerances.budget: v12 existing post-cast feasibility tolerance, fixed before evaluation

qualification.gradient_checks: Include lower R -> upper K/P -> upper v; fixed-P gradient parity is insufficient.
qualification.target_contract_checks: Stored R is actual solve RHS at every layer; no inherited residual appended; all layers with zero u retain nonzero potential gradient.
qualification.transaction: accepted payload exact copy, history once, all-column retention, observer no mutation, W/H/RNG restore
qualification.reference_first: Repair same-method implementation/numerical failures; no performance-based tolerance adjustment.
qualification.equivalence: Same mathematical objective/gradient to declared numerical tolerances, not universal bitwise equality of microbatch schedules. Near decision boundaries use original schedule.
qualification.probe_state: Deterministic stateless eval or exact per-group RNG/state replay is required for out-of-order complete-owner probing; otherwise original ordered two-pass path.

per_candidate: requested R/u norms and shared budget/slack
native NLL/KL/requested penalty and joint stopping
mean/canonical/context actual response vs requested R, directional/error metrics
native solve residual, Q, effective update norm
subject-masked vs actual prestate gap where observed
terminal: R/P new and N true strict TF/token/prompt ACC
joint candidate identity and commit equality
telemetry.expensive_metrics: Full actual task evaluator at W0/terminal only in first pilot; not every optimization candidate. Mandatory builder quantities reuse existing computation.
telemetry.estimated_speedup: NOT_MEASURED. B1 source measured5.287x V12 planner fit; no revised speed claim.
